decision: Maintain missing device availability in the existing daemon main thread with one-second bounded-cadence attempts. Keep existing shared output mutex and input listeners, at most one reader per kind/path. Never retry an edit. Observe the existing shutdown flag before acquisition/admission. Keyboard/pointer listener entry/exit advances the existing field epoch; consume it before idle deferred work and cancel stale gesture intent while retaining physical held-modifier tracking.
reason: Startup records a failed uinput acquisition permanently as None and discovers accessible keyboards only once. Late logind/udev permissions therefore cannot recover a still-running daemon. Current listeners and output contracts already provide the required owners; the main thread only needs to maintain readiness rather than block joining them.
